Hi Jordan,

I downloaded the "Inference cost & latency benchmark" you published last week and it looked promising for some of our generative pipelines. We're evaluating inference vendors and would like a short demo and cost/throughput discussion.

- Primary use: multitenant prompt pipelines for transaction enrichment and summarization (avg prompt ~150 tokens, spikes to 1,000).
- Curious about batching, KV caching, and private deployment options.

Available windows (PT):
- Today 2:00–3:30pm
- Tomorrow 11:00am–1:00pm
- Thursday afternoon after 3:00pm

I've attached a screenshot of the benchmark output and a short notes PDF with our workload numbers. Would prefer a 45-minute slot to include our CTO.

Thanks,

Head of ML, FinLytix
samir.shah@finlytics.io
